document_strings: My fathers brothers
RHINE - Died of an HEART ATTACK
MAX - was a PLUMBER also DIED OF HEART ATTACK
MEYER - was a P.A.
He died stepping away Lost by NAIL
My father had 1 sister. Her name was Mammie RABINOWITZ
I attended P.S. 161
After I graduated - I went to Hebre School on Crown Street
My teachers name was Mrs. Blenden
I was Bar Mitzvah ed on Thu Afternoon
My teachers name was MR. ZWERDING
AFTER GRADUATING HEBREW SCHOOL
I went to ALEXANDER HAMILTON High School where I stayed for 3 1/2 years
NEVER GRADUATED
I quit school because I NEVER LIKED SCHOOL
After I quit school I worked for my Father on WALTON ST. BROWNS
I worked for him for about 3 years
Farming house - After working for him - I joined THE CCC CAMP
They sent me to Bronx CADE where I stayed from 1939-1940
then I came home to CROWN ST. Couldn't find a job until I was DRAFTED in the U.S. ARMY AUG 7 1941
